The problem we discovered

"I spent a whole week looking for a hairdresser appointment before my sister's wedding. Everything was booked. On Saturday a friend told me my favourite salon had three free slots on Thursday. Nobody knew about them. They stayed empty."

This happens every day in thousands of local places in Poland.

Local businesses have loyal customers, but no effective, direct channel to reach them. The customer would have come – they just didn't know.

No effective channel

Social media posts get lost in the algorithm – no guarantee of reach

Own app out of reach

Too expensive and time-consuming for a small business

Loyalty app chaos

Users get lost in dozens of separate apps

Info arrives too late

Offers and events are gone before the customer finds out

FaveUp · Built with ❤️ for local businesses and their communities3 / 12

How we want to fix it

For the customer:

FaveUp is an app where customers follow their favourite local places and see only what's happening right now: offers, appointments and time-limited promotions. Zero algorithm, zero noise – only the places they chose themselves.

For the business:

On the business side: a simple web panel. You write a message, AI helps you make it short and engaging, and you send a push with one button – straight to people who consciously follow you. With a guarantee of instant delivery that Instagram doesn't give.

How does it work?

  1. 1The customer adds a place to favourites with a QR code on site or the map in the app

  3. 2You send short updates to your loyal customers

  5. 3The customer gets up-to-date information (news, events, promotions) without ads or algorithms

Test with us – from a single scan to a real customer relationship

We want to check whether a bonus really motivates customers to stay in touch with us.

01

Put a QR code at the till: a 10x10 cm sticker or a stand.

02

The cashier invites: “Scan the QR, a bonus for your next visit is waiting for you.”

03

Customer asks for details? Answer: “It's a new app to stay up to date with what's happening here – just sign up for the waitlist.”

04

The customer scans the QR and signs up: name and e-mail.

05

The system instantly sends the bonus by e-mail.

06

We count how many customers come back with the code. >10% = test success.

Conclusions

A positive result is the green light for the full version of the app, which you co-create as a Design Partner.

You start right away with a base of customers who want to stay up to date with your place.
